registration: 2026-10-21; registered before computing any walk2 isolated-pixel measurements, including the v1 reproduction
basis: ASSUMED image acceptance screens, not a botanical or cinematographic standard. Lead-reported v1 peak 15.6 isolated pixels per 10000 informs the preregistration; no new measurement used.
grayscale: Pillow RGB to L conversion; byte values from 0 to 255
isolated_pixel: Absolute grayscale difference from centered 3 by 3 median strictly greater than 35; exclude outermost one-pixel border
density: 10000 times number of isolated pixels divided by number of interior pixels
flicker: 10000 times count of exclusive-or between consecutive isolated-pixel masks divided by number of interior pixels; same screen coordinates, includes true motion conservatively
coverage: Every final frame and every adjacent pair at native 1920 by 1080 pixels; preview is diagnostic only. No percentile exemption.
reproduction_crop: Freeze frame 600 after visual inspection; crop coordinates recorded by value before construction changes

encoding.basis: ASSUMED no-new-artifacts screen using the lead's absolute developed RGB channel-error method; every frame, with fast-motion subset additionally identified by route speed and yaw upper quartiles
